newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares fall on Dadas bankruptcy talk.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares fall on Dadas bankruptcy talk.

text.p: Slovenian shares tumbled 2.56 percent on Wednesday, dragged down by a newspaper report that Dadas may face bankruptcy if the merger with Primofin is not approved by its shareholders, traders said.
No-one at Dadas was available for comment.
Uncertainty surrounding the makeup of the new government after Sunday's general election also weighed on prices.
"Some of Dadas' shareholders dissagree with the current conditions for the merger with Primofin, so they may oppose it," Dejan Bjelobaba, a trader of brokerage Fiba told Reuters.
* The SBI index fell 30.67 points to 1,165.6.
* Brokerage Dadas fell 13.50 percent or 1,620 tolars to 10,380 tolars on volume of 515 shares.
* Brokerage Primofin fell 6.45 percent or 2,000 tolars to close at 29,010 tolars on volume of 200 shares.
* Overall 17 shares fell and two rose, while five were untraded.
